info.title: Nighttroop
info.description: Nighttroop's JSON API. Each endpoint gives the host it is on: POST /site is on the public host; /api/... is the Nightscout API, on a site's Nightscout host; everything else is on a site's host, with a JWT from POST /login. Times are milliseconds since the epoch, and glucose is in the units of the signed in identity's settings, except on the Nightscout API, which always gives it in mg/dL, as Nightscout does; a Nightscout document says its units in its units field.

post.summary: Begins signing in with any of the site's passkeys: the WebAuthn options for navigator.credentials.get, its challenge kept in a cookie for 5 minutes

post.summary: Groups events already made, picked by their IDs
post.description: Needs group_type. Each ID sent must be of a kind the type can have, from GET /data/event-groups/choices, and at least one is needed, except for a change (a sensor, site or pump part), which has none. 400 when the type is missing or unknown, an ID is of a kind the type cannot have, none is sent, or an event does not exist; 409 when an event is already in another group.

get.summary: The events that can be put in a group of the type, from an hour before occurred_at to an hour after
get.description: Only events not deleted and in no other group, of the kinds the type can have; a change has none, so its list is empty. With group_id the group's own events are listed too, picked, wherever they are. Needs permission to both create and update event groups. 400 when group_type is missing or unknown; 404 when there is no group with group_id.

get.summary: The event group with the ID, with its events

post.summary: Sets the event group's events to those picked
post.description: The group's events become exactly the IDs sent, so an event not sent is taken out of the group, and kept. The type, time, notes, reason, sensor code and transmitter change only when sent; the other fields do not change. The errors are those of creating a group, and 404 when there is no group with the ID.

delete.summary: Deletes the event group with the ID and its events
delete.description: Marks the group and each of its events deleted, as the Nightscout API deletes a treatment, so syncing apps see the delete.

Skip.description: How many to skip, at most 32000

Before.name: before
Before.description: Pages by date, with no limit to how far back: the rows older than this time, in milliseconds. To get the page after a page, send its last row's occurred_at here and its id as before_id

BeforeId.name: before_id
BeforeId.description: With before, the id of a row at that time: the rows at that time with a smaller id are also older, as rows are ordered by occurred_at then id

BeforeDate.name: before_date
BeforeDate.description: The rows on or before this day, as 2006-01-02, in the timezone from the settings. It replaces before and before_id

NsSort.name: sort
NsSort.description: A field to sort by, ascending. On the date (date, created_at, mills, ...) the search is the oldest first; with a filter other than the date a page can have fewer than limit. Other fields are the newest first

NsSortDesc.name: sort$desc
NsSortDesc.description: A field to sort by, descending

NsFindDateGte.description: Documents from this time, in milliseconds

LoopSettingsList.description: Each set of the loop apps' settings, the last seen first

EventChoiceList.description: The events that can be grouped, by kind

SearchPage.description: A page of a search, newest first. A data collection also counts what its search matches over every page, and when the earliest and latest occurred, in ms, null when it matches none.

limit.description: 50 unless the request asks for another, at most 1000

url.description: The site's URL, for the browser and the site's API

pwd_ns_url.description: The PWD phone's Nightscout URL, on the site's Nightscout host

backup_key.description: Gets a new admin login on the recover page; it works once

read_only_nstoken.description: The read only device's Nightscout token

totp.description: A code from the authenticator app, for an admin

Record.description: What every record has. Read only fields are set by the server, which ignores them if sent.

occurred_at.description: Now, if not sent when creating

reading_type.description: sgv from a sensor or mbg from a meter

automatic.description: Whether a loop gave it, as Loop uploads a bolus; set only by a loop's upload, not the site

LoopSettings.description: A set of a loop app's settings, kept once however often it was sent: Loop's from its profiles, Trio's remote settings from its profiles, and AAPS's configuration from its device statuses

id.description: The SHA-256 of the app and the settings, in hex

source.description: What they were sent in: profile or devicestatus

settings.description: As the app sent them, without Loop's or Trio's deviceToken for an identity that can only read the site's data

previous_id.description: The set of the same app last seen before this one; only on a set read alone, null for an app's first

changes.description: The settings that differ from the previous set, glucose in units; only on a set read alone

LoopSettingsChange.description: A setting that differs from the set before, by its names joined by dots, a preset's by its name

old.description: As it reads, null when it was not sent

new.description: As it reads, null when it is not sent

source.description: direct, or the connector that wrote it: nightscout, dexcom, libre or virtual

rate.description: U/hr while it runs; 0 is a suspended basal

multiplier.description: Times the scheduled basal at its start, so 0.5 is half

EventGroupType.description: A type of group the site can add: a Nightscout treatment's eventType. A change (Sensor Start, Sensor Stop, Sensor Change, Site Change, Cannula Fill, Prime, Insulin Change, Reservoir Change, Pump Battery Change) needs no events; all but Cannula Fill, Prime and Reservoir Change can have a glucose.

EventKind.description: A kind of event, named by the event group's field for its ID

allOf.description: A Nightscout treatment: events recorded together, like a meal bolus's reading, food and insulin. Each event is in at most one group. A group picks its events by their IDs, each null when it has none of that kind; a glucose reading, insulin dose, food intake, temp basal or temp target is also read back whole, null when it has none.

group_type.description: The treatment's eventType: one of EventGroupType when the site adds it, any the Nightscout API has when an app uploads it

duration_minutes.description: Set when creating; an edit does not change it

sensor_code.description: A sensor change's sensor code, as xDrip+ sends it

pump_id.description: The pump the app named, as AAPS does on every treatment; the site does not set it

EventChoice.description: An event that can be put in a group

id.description: The event's ID, sent as the group's field named by kind

amount.description: A reading's glucose or a temp target's low target, in the units of the identity's settings; a dose's U; a food's carbs in g; a temp basal's U/hr

minutes.description: How long a temp basal, temp target, profile switch or activity lasts

detail.description: What else tells it apart: a reading's or dose's type, a food's or profile's name, an activity's name or type, a notification's title, or a temp target's high target in mg/dL

picked.description: Whether it is in the group of group_id

SummaryPeriod.description: A period from start until end, named by its first date. Its times in each range are of all its days' readings, so a day of few counts for little; its daily dose and daily carbs are the means of its days with data that are over, or of all of them when none is; and its glucose the mean of those days every 5 minutes from midnight. Its AGP is each 5 minutes from midnight the 5th, 25th, 50th, 75th and 95th percentiles of its days' glucose in the 15 minutes around it, empty when there was none; a day's is of the 7 days to it. Its glucose readings are all its days', with their mean, standard deviation, coefficient of variation and GMI, and its times very low (below 54 mg/dL), low, in range, high and very high (above 250 mg/dL) add up to 100.

days.description: How many of its days have data

total_daily_basal.description: The basal of its daily dose, in U; the rest is boluses

glucose_readings.description: Its glucose readings, a meter's and CGMs'

meter_readings.description: Its glucose readings from a meter

mean.description: The mean of its glucose readings, in units

sd.description: The standard deviation of its glucose readings, in units

cv.description: The coefficient of variation, its standard deviation as a percent of its mean

gmi.description: The glucose management indicator, the HbA1c percent its mean is estimated to give

time_very_low.description: The percent of its readings below 54 mg/dL

time_low.description: The percent of its readings from 54 mg/dL to below the range

time_high.description: The percent of its readings above the range up to 250 mg/dL

time_very_high.description: The percent of its readings above 250 mg/dL

cgm_active.description: The percent of its 5 minutes, up to now, with a CGM reading

SummaryLoopSlots.description: The loop's IOB in U or COB in g every 5 minutes from midnight, as glucose is: a day's newest loop device report then, or else in the 5 minutes before, as one is kept only every 10 minutes once an hour old, null when there was none, and a week's or month's the mean of its days' then, to 2 decimals

Summary.description: The parts of the summary described here; the rest is kept in AdditionalProperties

NsDocument.description: A Nightscout document, such as an entry or treatment; the fields named here are common to most, the rest are kept in AdditionalProperties

units.description: The units of sgv and mbg, always mg/dL

SiteUsage.description: A site's storage, as its Usage page shows it

size_kb.description: The DB size in KB; after a truncate, the size after it. Null when it was never measured.

limit_kb.description: The DB size limit in KB, null when there is none

before_size_kb.description: The DB size in KB before a truncate; null in GET /usage, or when it was never measured

tables.description: The DB's tables as last measured, largest first; empty when they cannot be measured

SiteTable.description: A table of a site's DB

bytes.description: The bytes the table and its indexes take in the DB file
